nina.cs: Proposal: an A/B prefill experiment runbook for medium-touch accounts. A: conservative (3 prefills, 30m TTL). B: aggressive (10 small prefills, 90m TTL + batch=4). Purpose: measure first-token latency delta and customer feedback to reduce renewal risk. Thoughts? :microscope:

sam.sre: Good idea. Key ops constraints: keep prefill QPS per account <=0.5, avoid affecting autoscaler. Emit distinct metrics for variants: warm.ab.a_ok / warm.ab.b_ok and warm.ab.latency.delta.

jorge.pm: For CS messaging include clear privacy line: "No model training; ephemeral cache only." Also add a one-question feedback CTA after onboarding: "Did the first response feel fast? Yes/No" linking to a tiny webhook.

nina.cs: Customer-facing A example (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "X-Prefill-TTL:30m" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-1","input":"Summarize: <short>"}'
```

sam.sre: B variant uses small batches, example config: `{"batch_size":4,"max_tokens":28,"prefill_ttl":"90m"}`. Internally route to `queue:prefill-ab` so we can throttle independently.

jorge.pm: Experiment telemetry: capture warm.variant, warm.success, warm.errors, crm.warm_flag. If a variant yields >10% errors or no latency improvement after 24h, auto-disable and route to CS for manual follow-up.

nina.cs: Renewal risk rule: if account reports poor feedback OR warm.attempts>=2 & warm.last_status=fail then create CRM task `warm_handhold` and notify AE.

sam.sre: Rollback/clear snippet (internal):
```
# internal - clear AB prefill keys for account
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.local/admin/cache/clear \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN>" \
  -d 'account_id=ACCT999&scope=prefill_ab'
```

jorge.pm: Also include rate-limit fallback: on 429 backoff with jitter, try single probe after 60s; if 3 consecutive 429s mark as `warm.rate_limited` and escalate.

ops-bot: Action created: Add AB warmup card to account view (owners: cs-team, eng-platform).

nina.cs: I'll write the customer short blurb + internal experiment checklist. Will post drafts and a small dashboard prototype tomorrow. :seedling:
